meta.name: cobrapy
meta.description: Constraint-based metabolic modeling (COBRA). FBA, FVA, gene knockouts, flux sampling, SBML models, for systems biology and metabolic engineering analysis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对代谢网络进行约束性建模与通量分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要分析代谢网络、预测基因敲除或进行通量平衡分析。
copy.tagline_en: Perform constraint-based modeling and flux analysis of metabolic networks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to analyze metabolic networks, predict gene knockouts, or perform flux balance analysis.

howto.what: Claude 能使用 COBRApy 库加载、构建和导出代谢模型（SBML/JSON/YAML），并进行通量平衡分析（FBA）、通量可变性分析（FVA）、基因敲除、通量采样等计算，以预测细胞代谢行为。
howto.when: 当用户请求处理代谢模型、运行 FBA/FVA、进行基因或反应敲除分析、优化生长培养基，或进行代谢工程模拟时触发。

say.text: 加载大肠杆菌核心模型并计算最大生长速率。
对模型 PFK 基因进行单敲除，分析生长变化。
计算模型在厌氧条件下的最小培养基组成。

howto.what_en: Claude can use the COBRApy library to load, build, and export metabolic models (SBML/JSON/YAML), perform flux balance analysis (FBA), flux variability analysis (FVA), gene/reaction knockouts, flux sampling, and other computations to predict cellular metabolism.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests loading or analyzing metabolic models, running FBA/FVA, performing gene or reaction knockout studies, optimizing growth media, or conducting metabolic engineering simulations.

say_en.text: Load the E. coli core model and compute the maximum growth rate.
say_en.note: Claude will call load_model('e_coli_core') and run optimize().

say_en.text: Knock out the PFK gene and analyze growth change.
say_en.note: Claude uses single_gene_deletion and returns results.

say_en.text: Compute minimal medium composition under anaerobic conditions.
say_en.note: Claude calls minimal_medium with exchange reaction adjustments.
